name: data-processing-pipeline
description: Job with task dependencies forming a DAG (Directed Acyclic Graph)

payload.script: import json; data = json.load(open('/tmp/raw_data.json')); assert 'records' in data; print(f'Validated {len(data["records"])} records')

import json; data = json.load(open('/tmp/raw_data.json')); metrics = [r['metric'] for r in data['records']]; json.dump(metrics, open('/tmp/metrics.json', 'w')); print(f'Extracted {len(metrics)} metrics')
import json; data = json.load(open('/tmp/raw_data.json')); labels = [r['label'] for r in data['records']]; json.dump(labels, open('/tmp/labels.json', 'w')); print(f'Extracted {len(labels)} labels')

import json; metrics = json.load(open('/tmp/metrics.json')); labels = json.load(open('/tmp/labels.json')); result = {'total_metrics': len(metrics), 'total_labels': len(labels), 'avg_metric': sum(metrics)/len(metrics) if metrics else 0}; json.dump(result, open('/tmp/aggregated.json', 'w')); print(result)
